subject: Request: short-term eval safety net while PO clears
messages:
From: Morgan Ellis <morgan.ellis@pulsehealth.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, camila.reyes@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 15:15:00 -0700
Subject: Trial environment at risk — procurement delay

Hi Vanessa / Camila,

Quick note — our procurement team has pulled the PO review into another cycle and it looks like the signed PO won't land until next Wednesday. We're mid-demo and several clinical users still need to validate the Redwood integration; if the trial times out we'll lose momentum.

Question: is there any way Redwood can keep the sandbox active for an extra week or provide a small top-up of credits so we can finish verification while procurement completes the PO? Procurement is willing to expedite once they have an internal approval but their calendar is out of our control.

Deal details: PulseHealth — evaluation running since May 10, primary use is secure summarization + triage. Contact for procurement is procurement@pulsehealth.com.

Appreciate any short-term help — low friction would be ideal (a temporary credit or 7–10 day extension).

Thanks,
Morgan Ellis
Head of Clinical Integrations
PulseHealth

--
Please see attached: pulsehealth_po_draft.pdf (pdf, draft PO from procurement)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Morgan Ellis <morgan.ellis@pulsehealth.com>
Cc: camila.reyes@redwood.com, david.kim@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 17:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial environment at risk — procurement delay

Hi Morgan — thanks for the context and for forwarding the draft PO.

We can absolutely help keep things moving. I can offer a 7-day evaluation window extension plus a provisional 5k token credit to maintain demo throughput while procurement finishes. This is intended to be a short stopgap — Finance will need to log it as a promotional credit against DEAL-2384.

Next steps I propose:
- I’ll loop in David (billing/finance) to log the credit and mark the account so we don’t auto-shutdown.
- If procurement can share the expected PO date, we’ll align extension end-date accordingly (we can extend further by exception if PO pushes out further).

Morgan — does 7 days + 5k tokens cover what you need to finish validation? If yes I’ll start the process now and send you a provisional credit note.

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Vanessa / Camila,

I can approve a provisional credit and a 7-day timer pause for a customer in sales evaluation, but I need the following before I push it through the billing system:
1) Confirmation from sales (Vanessa) that this is a one-time stopgap tied to DEAL-2384.
2) A short note on expected PO date (to document escalation if finance needs to reconcile later).
3) Approval from your manager if the credit exceeds $1,000 equivalent (our promo credit cap). 5k tokens roughly maps to ~$1,200 based on the current trial rate — that exceeds the cap so I’ll need an approval note.

If you can reply with manager approval (can be a one-line OK), I’ll generate the provisional-credit-note.pdf and mark the account as "on hold" for auto-shutdown. I’ll also add an internal tag so CS knows not to close the trial.

Thanks,
David Kim
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference

Thanks for the PO draft and the expected PO ETA (6/16) — that works. Per David’s note, I’ve approved the provisional credit as an exception for DEAL-2384; David, consider this the one-line manager approval for the promotional credit cap.
